title: Smiling Mature Couple in Backyard Alleyway, 1958 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot with deckled borders, dated 'Autumn 58' on the front margin, showing an affectionate mature couple standing closely together in an outdoor passageway beside a stone and brick house. The woman is smiling, wearing a domestic apron over a patterned skirt, while the man wears glasses, a short-sleeve patterned shirt, and pleated trousers. A long stone retaining wall borders a sloped lane leading towards residential homes and a parked car in the background.
